subject.title: fix #95895: [Security]: GEMINI_API_KEY written as a plaintext literal in the generated systemd service unit

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrowed Google/Gemini auth-profile EnvironmentFile policy, or require a broader generic auth-profile credential-rendering policy before this bug fix lands?
rationale: The existing metadata seam is the right systemd repair boundary, but the provider-specific allowlist and cross-platform behavior are security and compatibility choices that CI cannot settle.

options.title: Accept Narrow Policy After Platform Fix
options.body: Fix the Windows metadata mismatch, then merge the Google/Gemini-specific file-backed auth-profile behavior as the smallest security repair.

options.title: Request Generic Auth-Profile Policy
options.body: Ask for a revised PR that routes auth-profile env refs through a common provider/auth policy instead of a Google/Gemini allowlist.

options.title: Pause This PR
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause this PR if maintainers want the auth-profile path handled in separate security work.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Policy After Platform Fix
recommendation.body: Fix the Windows metadata mismatch, then merge the Google/Gemini-specific file-backed auth-profile behavior as the smallest security repair.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and authored the related config SecretRef repair for this same issue and have the strongest recent maintainer-side context for this service-env boundary.
